rows.description: 📚 Sync skills, agents, MCP, plugins to all AI CLI tools with one command and simplify team sharing.
A cross-platform desktop app to manage Agent Skills in one place and sync them to multiple AI coding tools’ global skills directories — “Install once, sync everywhere”.

Free, open-source desktop manager for AI Agent Skills. Write a skill once, sync it to 32 AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more) via symlinks. Local-first, MIT licensed. macOS, Windows, Linux.
